title: Future Scientists Scholarship (منحة علماء المستقبل) 2026/2027 — Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research and Central Bank of Egypt
official_source: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (Egypt), in cooperation with the Central Bank of Egypt
duration: Until graduation from the participating national university (الأهلية)
description: A fully funded Egyptian government scholarship for students who have just finished secondary school, awarded by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research with the Central Bank of Egypt. It pays the full cost of study plus accommodation and living expenses at participating national universities until graduation, in nine specialisms that the state designates as priorities. Selection starts from the secondary school total mark with a geographic allocation across governorates, then an admission test. Applications for 2026/2027 ran from 29 August to 4 September 2026 and have closed.

title: KINGS Master's Scholarship 2027 (KEPCO International Nuclear Graduate School, South Korea) — non-employee quota announced by Iraq's Ministry of Higher Education
official_source: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (Iraq), Department of Missions and Cultural Relations
description: A master's degree scholarship for the 2027 intake at the KEPCO International Nuclear Graduate School (KINGS) in South Korea, offered to the non-employee category of applicants by Iraq's Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research. Places cover nuclear power plant engineering and energy policy and engineering. Applications are submitted through the ministry's Missions and Cultural Relations portal and close on 26 October 2026, so the award is open now.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Cape Town (2027 intake, postgraduate)
program_type: Foundation-funded need-based scholarship administered by a university
duration: The full period of the UCT programme of study; renewable annually subject to satisfactory academic performance and personal conduct and participation in the programme's development activities
description: A fully funded scholarship and support programme for African students at the University of Cape Town, delivered in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation. Applicants must be citizens of an African country and must face significant social and economic barriers to accessing higher education; UCT states it encourages applications from young women, people living with disabilities, refugees and forcibly displaced youth. It covers a first bachelor's degree, a postgraduate diploma in the Faculty of Health Sciences, an honours degree or a coursework master's degree at UCT, but not part-time study

title: E-JUST TICAD8 African Scholarships for Science, Technology and Innovation
official_source: Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology (E-JUST)
program_type: Government-funded full scholarship for African nationals, delivered by a national university
duration: The period necessary to complete the degree requirements in E-JUST - two years for the M.Sc. degree in addition to six months of preparatory courses if necessary
description: A fully funded master's scholarship offered by the Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology under the cooperation of the Egyptian government and the Japan International Cooperation Agency, for nationals of African countries other than Egypt. It covers tuition, accommodation, a monthly stipend, medical care and return airfare, and runs for the period needed to complete the M.Sc. degree requirements. Applicants who will return to employment at their home institution are preferred and must have their application endorsed by that institution.

title: AUF Virtual Mobility Grant for International Distance Degree Programmes (FOAD/IFIC call 2026/27)
official_source: Agence universitaire de la Francophonie (AUF) / Institut de la Formation a Distance de la Francophonie (IFIC)
duration: Duration of the chosen distance degree programme, from licence to doctorat
description: With the support of IFIC, the Agence universitaire de la Francophonie supports francophone students through a virtual international mobility allowance in the form of partial coverage of enrolment fees, accompanied by support from application to diploma and free access to AUF offices worldwide, so that students can obtain an international university degree at a distance without leaving their country of residence.

title: Qatar University International Students Scholarship
official_source: Qatar University, Office of the Vice President for Student Affairs — Scholarships Section
duration: Full-time undergraduate degree at Qatar University
description: Qatar University offers an International Students Scholarship to international students who apply to its undergraduate programmes, selected on a competitive basis. Applicants must hold a high school certificate or equivalent with a minimum average of 95% and receive final acceptance from the university. The award covers full tuition and textbook fees, pays a monthly salary of 500 QAR, and includes student housing with campus transport, an annual round-trip air fare ticket and a residence permit under Qatar University sponsorship. official_source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Brunei Darussalam
duration: Diploma, undergraduate degree or postgraduate master's degree programme, full-time, commencing at the July/August academic year intake
description: The Government of Brunei Darussalam Scholarship to Foreign Students Tenable in Brunei Darussalam (BDGS) is administered by Brunei's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and covers Diploma, Undergraduate Degree and Postgraduate Master's Degree study at Universiti Brunei Darussalam, Universiti Islam Sultan Sharif Ali, Universiti Teknologi Brunei, Kolej Universiti Perguruan Ugama Seri Begawan and Politeknik Brunei.
